import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

df = pd.read_csv('data.csv')

# Aggregate total sales per product and size
aggregated = df.groupby(['product', 'size'])['total'].sum().reset_index()

plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
sns.barplot(x='product', y='total', hue='size', data=aggregated)
plt.title('Total Sales per Product and Size')
plt.ylabel('Total Sales')
plt.xlabel('Product')
plt.xticks(rotation=45)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png')
plt.show()
